info.name:
Lists available cloud services and their associated SKUs for a given vendor.
Use this to retrieve service codes and names that can be referenced in exclude service settings.

params.name: vendor
params.description: Required. Cloud vendor (e.g., "gcp"). Bound from the URL path.

params.name: code
params.description:
Optional. Service code to filter by.
Example values: "6F81-5844-456A" (Cloud Storage), "95FF-2EF5-5EA1" (Compute Engine),
"152E-C115-5142" (Cloud SQL).
Use ListServices without this field to retrieve all available service codes.

items.docs:
Lists available cloud services and their associated SKUs for a given vendor.
